trigger: incorrect delayed or missing safe question route
immediate_action: stop affected workflow and protect unresolved questions
restart_evidence: incident review corrected route and dry run
restart_authority: clinical decision owner and patient co-lead

trigger: contact without current consent or against recorded preference
immediate_action: stop contact and investigate all affected records
restart_evidence: corrected consent process and affected-person response
restart_authority: privacy lead clinical owner and patient co-lead

trigger: requested language format interpreter proxy or non-digital route unavailable
immediate_action: pause affected offer route and provide safe alternative

trigger: patient co-lead withdraws or rejects the proposal
immediate_action: pause progression and retain the reason
restart_evidence: new direct agreement or documented stop decision

trigger: invalid denominator scoring skip or item-missingness logic
immediate_action: stop result use and correct records

trigger: unsupported group estimate or contrast is reported
immediate_action: withdraw claim and correct all outputs
stop data use and preserve incident record
restart_evidence: formal review and approved corrective action
redesigned workflow and direct partner review

trigger: staff time or capacity exceeds approved limit
teaching result is presented as official HCAHPS reporting
model patient or group targeting appears
immediate_action: stop model use and remove targeting logic

trigger: results are not returned by agreed date
restart_evidence: dated accessible response and capacity plan

trigger: accountable clinical patient or governance ownership is lost
immediate_action: pause work until roles are restored
restart_evidence: named accepted owners and renewed review
